preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'audit_trail' AND constraint_name = 'audit_trail_action_type_check' AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'

changeSet.comment: Update audit_trail action_type constraint to include REQUEST_SHIFT_DISCREPANCY_APPROVE and REQUEST_SHIFT_DISCREPANCY_DECLINE. This allows audit trail entries when a manager approves or rejects a cashier shift discrepancy request.
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the existing constraint ALTER TABLE audit_trail DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS audit_trail_action_type_check;
